author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: গ্রাফ/চার্ট/টেবিলটি বর্ণনা করে লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: The graph shows the literacy rate of Bangladesh over five years: 2019 - 62%, 2020 - 65%, 2021 - 68%, 2022 - 72%, 2023 - 75%. Describe the graph in a paragraph.
items.model: The graph shows the literacy rate of Bangladesh from 2019 to 2023. It is clear from the graph that the literacy rate rose steadily during this period. In 2019 the literacy rate was 62 percent. It increased to 65 percent in 2020 and further to 68 percent in 2021. The rise continued in the following years, reaching 72 percent in 2022. Finally, in 2023 the literacy rate climbed to its highest point of 75 percent. Thus, over the five years, the literacy rate went up by 13 percent without any fall. To sum up, the graph shows a continuous improvement in the literacy rate of Bangladesh. This indicates the success of education programmes and the growing awareness of the people about the importance of education.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
rose, increased, reached ইত্যাদি শব্দ ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of mobile phone users (in millions) in a country: 2018 - 90, 2019 - 110, 2020 - 130, 2021 - 150, 2022 - 170. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of mobile phone users in a country from 2018 to 2022. It is seen from the graph that the number of users increased steadily every year. In 2018 the number of mobile phone users was ninety million. It rose to one hundred and ten million in 2019 and to one hundred and thirty million in 2020. The number kept rising and reached one hundred and fifty million in 2021. At last, in 2022 the number of users climbed to its highest point of one hundred and seventy million. Thus the number of users doubled in almost five years. To sum up, the graph shows a rapid and continuous growth in the number of mobile phone users. This indicates the spread of modern technology and its growing use in daily life.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি

items.prompt: The pie chart shows how a family spends its monthly income: Food 40%, House rent 25%, Education 15%, Medical 10%, Savings 10%. Describe the chart.
items.model: The pie chart shows how a family spends its monthly income. The income is spent on five main items: food, house rent, education, medical and savings. According to the chart, the family spends the largest part of its income on food, which is 40 percent. The second largest amount, 25 percent, is spent on house rent. Education takes 15 percent of the income. The rest is spent on other needs. The family spends 10 percent on medical treatment and keeps only 10 percent as savings. To sum up, the chart makes it clear that the family spends most of its income on food and house rent, while only a small part is kept as savings. This shows that the cost of living is high and it is hard for the family to save much money.
rubric: শুরুতে chart কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
largest, second largest ইত্যাদি শব্দ ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The table shows the favourite games of the students of a class: Football 20, Cricket 15, Badminton 8, Swimming 5, Others 2. Describe the table.
items.model: The table shows the favourite games of the students of a class. Five categories of games are mentioned in the table. It is seen from the table that football is the most popular game, as twenty students like it. Cricket comes next with fifteen students. Badminton is liked by eight students, while swimming is the favourite of five students. Only two students like other games. So the total number of students in the class is fifty. To sum up, the table makes it clear that most of the students of the class prefer outdoor games like football and cricket, while only a few like other games. This shows that the students are fond of physical exercise and active games, which are good for their health.

items.prompt: The graph shows the number of trees planted in a school over five years: 2019 - 100, 2020 - 150, 2021 - 120, 2022 - 200, 2023 - 250. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the number of trees planted in a school from 2019 to 2023. It is clear from the graph that the number of trees planted generally increased over the years, though there was one fall. In 2019 the school planted one hundred trees. The number rose to one hundred and fifty in 2020. However, in 2021 it fell to one hundred and twenty. After that, the number rose sharply to two hundred in 2022 and reached the highest point of two hundred and fifty in 2023. To sum up, though there was a small drop in 2021, the number of trees planted increased steadily over the five years. This shows the growing awareness of the school and its students about the importance of tree plantation.

items.prompt: The table shows the daily routine of a student (hours per day): Study 7, Sleep 8, School 5, Meals 2, Games 2. Describe the table.
items.model: The table shows how a student spends the twenty-four hours of a day. Five activities are mentioned: study, sleep, school, meals and games. According to the table, the student spends the largest part of the day sleeping, which is eight hours. The next largest amount of time, seven hours, is spent on study at home. He passes five hours at school. The remaining hours are spent on other activities. He gives two hours to meals and two hours to games. To sum up, the table makes it clear that the student spends most of his time on sleep and study, while keeping a small time for games. This shows that he is serious about his studies but also keeps some time for rest and recreation, which is necessary for good health.

items.prompt: The graph shows the yearly rainfall (in cm) of a district: January 5, April 20, July 55, October 30, December 8. Describe the graph.
items.model: The graph shows the amount of rainfall in a district in different months of a year. The rainfall is measured in centimetres. It is clear from the graph that the rainfall was not the same throughout the year. In January the rainfall was very low, only five centimetres. It rose to twenty centimetres in April. The rainfall reached its highest point in July, when it was fifty-five centimetres. After July it began to fall. It came down to thirty centimetres in October and to only eight centimetres in December. To sum up, the graph makes it clear that the rainfall was highest in the middle of the year, during the rainy season, and lowest in the winter months. This shows the seasonal nature of rainfall in our country.
rubric: শুরুতে graph কী দেখায় তা বলেছি
rose, highest, fall ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করেছি

items.prompt: The pie chart shows the sources of energy used in a country: Gas 45%, Coal 20%, Oil 15%, Solar 12%, Others 8%. Describe the chart.
items.model: The pie chart shows the sources of energy used in a country. Five sources of energy are shown in the chart. According to the chart, gas is the main source of energy, which supplies 45 percent of the total. Coal comes next and supplies 20 percent of the energy. Oil provides 15 percent, while solar energy provides 12 percent. The remaining 8 percent comes from other sources. To sum up, the chart makes it clear that the country depends mostly on gas and coal for its energy, while clean sources like solar energy supply only a small part. This shows that the country should use more renewable energy like solar power to protect the environment and to save its limited gas and coal.
